content: Root cause: The bug was caused by using the incorrect engine ID when signaling a semaphore in the Intel graphics driver. The code was using `waiter->id` instead of the correct `waiter->hw_id`, which led to improper targeting of the semaphore signal. This mismatch arose due to the introduction of a distinct engine ID (`engine->id`) that differed from the hardware ID (`engine->hw_id`), necessitating the fix to ensure the correct hardware ID is used for semaphore signaling.
